svg.title: A shared tyre-force budget
svg.desc: A constant circular envelope has a capacity of 100 illustrative force units. The initial requested combination is 60 longitudinal and 60 cornering units: its resultant is 84.9, within the circle. At 60 longitudinal units, at most 80 cornering units remain. Raising cornering demand to 90 would put the resultant outside the envelope. Forces are teaching quantities, not driver-control percentages or a Porsche tyre model.

g.text: One tyre, a shared grip budget
